note: Zapata County publishes its zoning only as the 2009 Zapata County & Falcon Lake Area Zoning Regulations PDF (text, no district polygons). No county or city zoning district layer found as an ArcGIS REST or other queryable service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and web turned up only commercial parcel products (Regrid, taxnetusa, texascountygisdata, rockfordmap) with zoning fields behind paywalls or subscriptions, and two unidentified Zoning_Districts services that are not Zapata's.
